scenes.label: What a chatbot *actually* does
scenes.say: What does a website chatbot actually do for a small business? Watch.

messages.say: It's 11pm. A customer asks: are you open Sunday?
messages.cap: 11pm. A customer asks: *are you open Sunday?*

messages.text: Yes! Sunday 10am–4pm. Want me to book you in?
messages.say: The chatbot answers in two seconds, and offers to book.
Booked. While the owner was asleep.

scenes.say: How it works. One: it's trained on your own info. Your hours, services and FAQs.
scenes.cap: Trained on *your* hours, services and FAQs.

scenes.say: Two: it answers the questions you get every single day, around the clock.
scenes.cap: Answers the *same questions* you get daily. 24/7.

scenes.say: Three: when it doesn't know, it takes their details and sends them straight to you.
scenes.cap: Doesn't know? It *passes the customer to you.*

scenes.title: Would you add one to *your* site?
scenes.body: Follow for more AI tips for small business.
scenes.say: Would you add one to your website? Follow for more.
